## Verdict: APPROVE (prose-only Phase 3.2 tally instruction; correct against HEAD; all gates discharged)

### Scope
Self-review of DevFlow's own engine surface. Branch issue-1835-... vs main, head_override=local. Diff (3 files, ~19 lines) adds a `simplify outcome:` tally `--note` to the Phase 3.2 `workpad.py update --tick-progress "simplify"` call in skills/implement/phases/phase-3-review.md, documents it in docs/internal/implement-skill.md, and adds a changeset.

### Diff classification (Phase 0.5)
engine_self_modifying=true (Arm 1: skills/**) — overrides the small_diff+config_only checklist skip, so the full Phase 1+2 checklist ran (checklist_skipped=null). small_diff=true, config_only=true, has_new_types=false. Phase 3 roster: the always-on four; type-design-analyzer gated out (has_new_types false), pr-test-analyzer gated out (config_only/docs-only, no test-file change, no non-config added code).

### Phase 1+2 verification checklist
9 items generated, 9 PASS, 0 FAIL, 0 INCONCLUSIVE (1 via lite probe, rest agent/orchestrator-verified). Key confirmations against scripts/workpad.py: (VC-1) `update` accepts `--tick-progress` and `--note` together (both action='append' on the update subparser); (VC-2) `--note` bullets nest under ## Progress per workpad.py docstring; (VC-3) the `/simplify` progress row exists so tick substring `simplify` matches; (VC-7) lead phrase `simplify outcome:` present in the skill body; (VC-9) changeset `bump: patch` in VALID_BUMPS and `type: Added` in CANONICAL_TYPES.

### Phase 3 findings
None. code-reviewer, silent-failure-hunter, comment-analyzer, and the requesting-code-review final pass all returned APPROVE / no findings. The documented command form is truthful against HEAD (not a documented_falsehood). comment-analyzer and the final pass noted only a marginal, explicitly non-required style observation on line 40's justification clause ("written on every run, since §3.2 is unconditional") — not raised as a finding.

### Consumer review extension gates
- Prompt-surface edit routing evidence gate: TRIGGERED (diff touches skills/implement/phases/*.md) and DISCHARGED. Issue #1835 workpad carries two `Writing-skills evidence:` markers, each with all four slots explicit: skill-loaded=yes, guidance-applied=yes, pressure-scenario=no, micro-tests=no. All dispositions recorded, so discharged whatever the values (a `no` never draws a finding).
- Wording-only pin review policy: no new pins added — N/A.
- Shipped-prose cost audit (skills/** addition): the added block is lean; each added word is either the instruction or the one sentence naming what breaks. No finding.
- Verification-evidence marker advisory (non-blocking): this is a mid-flight implement-driven review-and-fix pass on issue #1835's workpad; advisory only and never gates the verdict.

### Verdict rationale (Phase 4.2)
No checklist FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; no self-contradicting-diff finding; no finding at/above the default `critical` threshold; no agent failed; checklist not skipped. → APPROVE.
